entries.reason: Broad Ridge/HGB correct-universe screen materially worse than persistence; useful screening null, not sole stop reason.
Some bounds informative, but many vacuous and Senate hard-threshold interpretation semantically invalid against direct reference.
Broad LOO-PRICE negative; corrected exact-equivalent structural comparator had zero usable rows.
Broad LOO-FAMILY negative and coherent QP priority-component estimates materially worse than persistence.
KL challenger likewise negative; no geometry rescue.
Valid stated completion rule inside partial-ID set, but tested point FV failed.
First count inverse had zero TRAIN support; global LOO-FAMILY target support was only 5 TRAIN markets vs 29 DEV. Large latent model not justified after simpler structural nulls.
Seat scalar and full CLR-distribution lead-lag tests produced no frozen-gate candidate; machine-speed response support was extremely sparse on DEV.
Supported House and Senate count distributions were much worse than persistence as contemporaneous point FV.
Corrected literal-next-target-update structural residuals were worse than persistence under QP and KL.
TRAIN-only affine calibration reduced scale mismatch but calibrated FV and error-correction residual both remained worse than persistence.
No candidate; the only favorable Senate 300s DEV response was one row on one day and failed frozen support gates.
No one of seven frozen narrow source-target pairs passed. Most had zero or one DEV response within 300s.
No core structural candidate existed to justify flow augmentation.
PRED-006 hazard is update likelihood, not directional FV; no R3 core signal justified augmentation.

stop_reason: After correcting the premature initial stop, the programme exercised assumption-free bounds, QP/KL coherent projections, MaxEnt completion, supported count surfaces, corrected next-update residuals, TRAIN-only affine calibration, scalar event-time lead-lag and full-distribution CLR lead-lag. No method passed its frozen TRAIN/DEV gate. Further post-result model expansion would be rescue search rather than disciplined confirmation.

controls.chronology: block_number,log_index; target-state inference used source blocks strictly before target block; event-time source shocks used target baseline before and response after the source block.
controls.semantics: Hard constraints only where reviewed settlement semantics supported them; Senate win/control threshold ambiguity was not promoted to identity.
controls.execution: Fills are repricing observations, not historical executable-PnL evidence.

retained_for_live_research: Live order-book information-leadership monitoring after launch
prohibited_claims: Do not claim R3 found a deployable structural alpha.
Do not claim historical fill tests prove absence of live order-book lead-lag.
Do not use isolated one-row Senate responses as evidence of alpha.
Do not open FINAL without a new independently preregistered programme.
